description: M/of Youth Affairs and Sports Under Section 41 Read with section 31 of the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973 as amended
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, amending eligibility criteria for positions in sports associations. This constitutes legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks, fitting Type 5 classification.
